product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps mid-market businesses collect customer feedback across channels, analyze it with AI, and act on insights to improve customer experience.
product_one_liner.notes: The customer case study describes mid-market brands as the target users and explains that the platform combines feedback touchpoints with AI-driven insights and action: https://startups.aws.com/learn/surveysparrow-turns-talk-into-traction-for-customer-experience.

pricing_page.notes: SurveySparrow has a public subscription pricing page at https://surveysparrow.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company's public customer list explicitly names Siemens and TATA Digital as users: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai. | named_customers.0: Siemens is explicitly named as a user at https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai. | named_customers.1: TATA Digital is explicitly named as a user at https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/13253328. This is a reported company-size band rather than an independently counted headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly gives a San Francisco headquarters address: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai. | hq_country: The headquarters address at https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai explicitly places the company in the USA.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly gives 2017 as its founding year at https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai.

eng_blog.notes: https://engineering.surveysparrow.com/ identifies its content as stories by SurveySparrow developers. At least two posts describe implementation work: Playwright sharding on Kubernetes (https://engineering.surveysparrow.com/slashing-qa-runtimes-with-playwright-sharding-on-kubernetes-k8s-b11c447952e6) and production SSE scaling using Redis (https://engineering.surveysparrow.com/scaling-real-time-applications-with-server-sent-events-sse-abd91f70a5c9). Individual engineering credentials were not explicit for every author, so authorship relies partly on the publication's description.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation includes OAuth guidance and multiple reference articles for contacts, webhooks and other resources: https://developers.surveysparrow.com/rest-apis.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-position list contains business development, design, account sales, marketing, partnerships, revenue operations and solution-engineering roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://surveysparrow.keka.com/careers. This negative is based on listed titles, not whether other jobs involve AI.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude Sonnet through Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai names OpenAI and Azure OpenAI for generative AI features. The AWS case study separately names Anthropic Claude Sonnet through Amazon Bedrock for summarization, clustering and sentiment scoring: https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/surveysparrow-turns-talk-into-traction-for-customer-experience.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center at https://security.surveysparrow.com/ lists SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA and GDPR under compliance. These are public compliance claims, not a statement that HIPAA or GDPR is an independently issued certification. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly listed at https://security.surveysparrow.com/. | compliance_certs.1: ISO/IEC 27001 is explicitly listed at https://security.surveysparrow.com/. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly listed at https://security.surveysparrow.com/; this records the public compliance claim. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is explicitly listed at https://security.surveysparrow.com/; this records the public compliance claim.

Its public funding profile displays the amount rounded to $1.42M and lists only that round: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/surveysparrow/__Gv8knohCbDJRtvW_3tttEQQ39HKqMrEWZqRcMaaB-IU/funding-and-investors. Confidence is reduced because the exact amount comes from a funding database rather than a primary announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile, updated October 11, 2026, lists only a November 2018 Seed round, outside the preceding 18 months: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/surveysparrow/__Gv8knohCbDJRtvW_3tttEQQ39HKqMrEWZqRcMaaB-IU/funding-and-investors.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists Business Development Representative - US and links to its posting at https://surveysparrow.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/90588. Its appearance in the open-position index supports current hiring, although the detail page does not separately declare an active status.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced SparrowCRM on September 3, 2026, within the six-month window: https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/computers-technology-and-internet/surveysparrow-launches-sparrowcrm-the-ai-native-agentic-crm-for-r-1216253.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The available executive page is marked unverified and provides no appointment dates; it does not establish a complete dated leadership roster. No qualifying dated appointment or departure was verified: https://theorg.com/org/surveysparrow/teams/executive-leadership.
